errors.unknown: Something went wrong ({{status}}). Please try again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check that it is running and try again.
errors.host_not_allowed: This host name is not allowed. Set TINDEERR_ALLOWED_HOSTS or TINDEERR_PUBLIC_URL on the server, or use its IP address.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.token_expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.refresh_token_reused: That session was signed out for safety. Sign in again.
errors.csrf_failed: The request was refused for safety reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.https_required: The console needs HTTPS. Put the server behind TLS, open it on localhost, or set TINDEERR_ALLOW_HTTP_CONSOLE=true for a private network.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.admin_required: Only an administrator can do that.
errors.media_server_admin_required: Only an administrator of the media server can do that.
errors.reauth_required: Confirm it is you before changing this.
errors.remote_access_denied: Your media server account is not allowed to connect from outside the local network.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.internal_error: The server hit an unexpected error.
errors.setup_required: This server still has to be set up.
errors.setup_completed: This server is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.invalid_setup_code: That setup code is not correct.
errors.setup_session_required: Start again from the setup code in this browser.
errors.setting_locked: That value is set by an environment variable on the server.
errors.not_a_server_user: That Plex account has no access to this server.
errors.password_sign_in_disabled: Password sign-in is turned off on this server.
errors.sign_in_method_unavailable: That sign-in method is not available on this server.
errors.pin_expired: The Plex code expired. Start again.
errors.plex_pin_pending: The Plex code has not been approved yet.
errors.plex_owner_required: That Plex account does not own this server.
errors.plex_tv_unreachable: plex.tv could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.quick_connect_unavailable: Quick Connect is turned off on the media server.
errors.quick_connect_expired: The Quick Connect code expired. Start again.
errors.media_server_unreachable: The media server could not be reached.
errors.media_server_changed: The media server no longer matches the one this server was set up with. An administrator has to fix the connector.
errors.pairing_expired: That pairing expired. Create a new QR code.
errors.pairing_not_awaiting_approval: No phone is waiting for approval on this code.
errors.public_url_not_set: An administrator of the media server has to set the public address first.
errors.public_url_unverified: That address did not answer as this server ({{reason}}).
errors.connector_unreachable: The address could not be reached.
errors.connector_unauthorized: The key or token was refused.
errors.connector_unexpected_response: The answer did not look like the expected server.
errors.media_server_unsupported: That server is not supported: check the type, and use Jellyfin 10.10 or newer.
errors.secret_required: Enter the key again after changing the address.
errors.last_admin: There has to be at least one enabled administrator.
errors.metadata_unreachable: The metadata service could not be reached.
errors.llm_auth_failed: The AI provider refused the key.
errors.llm_quota: The AI provider's quota is exhausted.
errors.llm_model_not_found: That model is unknown to the provider.
errors.llm_unreachable: The AI provider could not be reached.
errors.llm_invalid_output: The AI provider returned an unusable answer.
errors.no_backend_user: No matching user on the request backend.
errors.title_not_offered: That title is not on offer.
errors.request_backend_error: The request backend returned an error.
